activities.name: Kecak Fire Dance at Pura Uluwatu
activities.description: Bali's most atmospheric Kecak performance: 80 bare-chested chanters on a clifftop stage at the 11th-century Pura Luhur Uluwatu, 70m above the Indian Ocean. Performed daily at 18:00 — arrive by 17:30 for cliff-edge positioning. Combined temple + show ticket.

activities.name: Sunset at Single Fin
activities.description: Uluwatu's landmark cliff-edge bar: 50m above Impossibles / Bingin surf break, open-air thatched terraces, live DJ from 16:00 on Sundays. The view of the left-hand barrel below is unmatched. Book a terrace table for sunset — walk-ins standing only after 17:00.

activities.name: Surf at Bingin Beach
activities.description: A short left-hander that breaks over a shallow reef shelf, best at 3–6 ft with a solid SW swell. Steep paddle-out via 200 concrete steps from the clifftop car park. Intermediate level minimum — this is not a learner break. Closest lesson school operates from Padang Padang, 10 min by motorbike.

activities.name: Omnia Bali Day Club
activities.description: Cliff-edge infinity-pool day club with resident international DJs. Valid from 10:00; entry fee includes a drink credit. The pool hangs 100m over the Indian Ocean with unobstructed horizon views. Dress code enforced after 18:00.

activities.name: Jiwa Spa at Anantara
activities.description: Ocean-view treatment rooms with floor-to-ceiling glass overlooking the limestone cliffs. Signature 'Anantara Ritual': 3-hour journey combining traditional lulur rice-bran scrub, Balinese massage, and botanical bath. Non-hotel guests welcome with advance reservation.

activities.name: Nyang Nyang Secret Beach
activities.description: One of Uluwatu's most secluded beaches: 400 steep steps down a cliff face, 800m of white sand, and reliably clear water for snorkelling. No warungs — bring food and water. Gets crowded on weekends; weekday mornings are near-empty. No signage: look for the dirt track off Jl. Pantai Nyang Nyang.
